sections.government_and_administration:
- **DMK women’s wing protests reflect public anger against TVK govt: Stalin:** ‘Statewide protests drew large numbers of women, including those not affiliated to any political party’ ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/dmk-womens-wing-protests-reflect-public-anger-against-tvk-govt-stalin/articleshow/135410646.cms))
- **How significant is the TVK-led regime’s move to hold Social Justice Survey? Explained:** The feature of an ‘open column’, where respondents can state their caste during the second phase of the Census, to be carried out in most parts of the country during February next year, has forced many parties and other stakeholders to express concerns over the utility of the whole exercise ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/how-significant-is-the-tvk-led-regimes-move-to-hold-social-justice-survey-explained/article71649252.ece))
- **AMMK leader targets Tamil Nadu govt over power cuts, questions energy minister’s continuance:** TTV: TNPDCL, despite protests over unscheduled power cuts, refused to acknowledge the complaints ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/ammk-leader-targets-tamil-nadu-govt-over-power-cuts-questions-energy-ministers-continuance/articleshow/135410626.cms))
- **BJP March: Fadnavis Accuses Congress of Samvidhan Chori During Emergency:** Deccan Chronicle also reported on the development: "BJP Rally: Nitin Nabin Leads Loktantra Bachao March in Rohtak." ([Deccan Chronicle](https://news.google.?oc=5))
sections.political_parties_and_opposition:
- **Plea in Madras high court against extension of special officers tenure for rural local bodies:** Plea in Madras HC challenges Tamil Nadu’s extension of special officers for rural local bodies, seeking ward delimitation completion and elections across 37 districts. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/plea-in-madras-high-court-against-extension-of-special-officers-tenure-for-rural-local-bodies/articleshow/135410326.cms))
- **Bay of Bengal deep depression moves closer to Tamil Nadu; IMD warns of strong winds up to 75kmph, rain likely over next two days:** Squally winds are predicted along the Tamil Nadu coast, with moderate rainfall expected from Monday onward. A deep depression in the Bay of Bengal will affect weather conditions beginning Sunday afternoon. Wind speeds might reach up to 75 kilometers per hour, especially overnight. The India Meteorological Department has issued warnings to fishermen to avoid certain areas. Rainfall is anticipated to increase, particularly on Monday and Tuesday. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/bay-of-bengal-deep-depression-moves-closer-to-tamil-nadu-imd-warns-of-strong-winds-up-to-75kmph-rain-likely-over-next-two-days/articleshow/135420570.cms))
sections.assembly_courts_and_policy:
- **Plea in Madras HC seeks deadline for local body elections:** Urban Acres also reported on the development: "Tamil Nadu Local Body Elections Face Madras HC Plea." ([DT Next](https://news.google.?oc=5))
- **Madras High Court Advocates Association challenges 1965 Union Cabinet decision to continue English as common language for Supreme Court and all High Courts:** Says, the 1965 decision came to its notice only in 2025 pursuant to details obtained by a lawyer under the Right to Information Act, 2005 ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/madras-high-court-advocates-association-challenges-1965-union-cabinet-decision-to-continue-english-as-common-language-for-supreme-court-and-all-high-courts/article71648537.ece))
sections.district_developments:
- **Minister inaugurates modern paddy storage facilities in Cuddalore district:** The facilities, constructed with financial assistance under the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), have a combined storage capacity of 7,000 tonnes ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/minister-inaugurates-modern-paddy-storage-facilities-in-cuddalore-district/article71652117.ece))
- **Two persons held for possession of country-made guns, explosives:** Two Vellore arrests for possession of country-made guns, explosives, and hunting gear linked to a farmer and a tribal man. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/two-persons-held-for-possession-of-country-made-guns-explosives/article71649177.ece))
- **Man escapes from police custody before being lodged in Coimbatore Central Prison:** This is the second time Raghavan, a theft case convict, has escaped from police custody; four personnel suspended ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/convict-escapes-from-police-custody-before-being-lodged-in-coimbatore-central-prison/article71648346.ece))
- **Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses, recalls around 400 warders to plugs security gaps:** Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses after Theni jailbreak, recalling 300–400 warders to boost prison security; inside-campus industries continue. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/tamil-nadu-shuts-prison-enterprises-outside-campuses-recalls-around-400-warders-to-plugs-security-gaps/articleshow/135410725.cms))
